from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialStatement(BaseModel):
    """One reported fiscal year's financing activities cash flow from a single filing."""
    fiscal_year: int | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the data covers (e.g., 2020, 2021)")
    company_name_at_reporting: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in this filing")
    net_cash_provided_by_financing: float | None = Field(description="Net cash provided by financing activities, as a signed number")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The monetary unit (e.g., 'dollars')")
    filing_date_or_period_end: str | None = Field(description="When this filing was issued or what period it ends")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt from the source document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_statements: list[FinancialStatement]
